paper_summary: LM6 Al-Si alloy was vacuum-infiltrated at 700 C into packed beds (packing fraction 0.66-0.69) of 2-3 mm expanded soda-lime glass particles (EGP, 0.35 g/cc) to make syntactic metal foam beams and, in a single casting step, sandwich structures with integral Al-Si face sheets. Three-point bending gave a foam core Young's modulus of ~7007 MPa at 1.14 g/cc (power-law dependence on density, exponent ~2); FEA with this input matched sandwich stiffness within 1-3%, while the classical sandwich analytical model overestimated stiffness by 30-60% for thick faces; modelled mass savings of 11-31% versus solid Al.

records.sample_label: SMF (Al-Si / EGP syntactic metal foam beam, 28 x 10 x 80 mm)

processing.matrix_name: LM6 Al-Si alloy (10-13 wt.% Si), Norton Aluminium
processing.particle_grade: OMYA expanded soda-lime glass particles (EGP40), sieved 2-3 mm

structure.microstructure_notes: Packed bed of ellipsoidal closed-surface expanded glass beads (2-3 mm) infiltrated under ~0.9 bar vacuum in mould preheated to 300 C; density range 1.13-1.15 g/cc across samples.

test.specimen_notes: 3-point bending, 64 mm span, 0.1 mm/s crosshead, LVDT under load point, elastic response averaged over 4 load/unload cycles; modulus from Timoshenko thick-beam eq. 3. P/delta measured ~2700-2900 N/mm.

evidence.quote: The mean density, 1.14 g/cc (±0.006), corresponds to a Young's modulus of approximately 7000 MPa (7007 ±72)
evidence.location: Sec. Results, Simple beams and model validation (p.8) / Fig. 6

evidence.quote: The ellipsoidal beads, with a closed surface, have an average density of 0.35 g/cc [16] and were sieved between 2 and 3 mm in diameter.
A packing fraction in the range of 0.66 - 0.69 was obtained by tamping after filling
The infiltrant was an LM6 grade aluminium alloy, sourced from Norton Aluminium, heated to 700°C.

extraction_notes: Filler is expanded (porous, closed-surface) glass beads rather than thin-walled hollow microballoons; classed as particle_type 'other'. particle_volume_fraction 0.675 is the midpoint of the stated packing fraction range 0.66-0.69; particle_mean_diameter_um 2500 is the midpoint of the 2-3 mm sieve range. Only elastic modulus was measured (no strength/failure). Sandwich-structure stiffness data (Table 1: P/delta 20424, 28866, 38399, 48357 N/mm for 2, 3, 4, 5 mm face sheets on 10 mm core; FEA and analytical predictions) are structural stiffnesses, not material properties, and were not recorded. Al-Si reference beam modulus 70.2 GPa is not a foam and was not recorded. Mass-saving figures (11-31%) are FE model results.
